# Gemma 3 vision reference fixtures

What the Rust Gemma 3 image preprocessing and prompt layout must reproduce,
generated by Hugging Face's own processor from OpenVINO/gemma-3-12b-it-int4-ov's
configs, tokenizer and chat template (no weights):
`tools/vlm_fixtures/gen_gemma3_fixtures.py` (transformers 5.14.1, Pillow 12.3;
versions are recorded in the JSON).

The images are the Gemma 4 fixture PNGs (`../gemma4_vision/*.png`), not stored
twice. `reference.json` holds:

- `processor`: 896x896, `resample` 2 (bilinear), rescale 1/255, mean/std 0.5;
  `image_seq_length` 256 and the processor's `full_image_sequence`.
- `tokens`: `<image_soft_token>`, `<start_of_image>`, `<end_of_image>` and ids.
- `images.<name>`: summaries (shape, sums, first/last 64 values, every 1009th
  value) of `pixel_values` for the PIL (`slow`) and torchvision (`fast`)
  processors, and how far they differ (one 8-bit level at most).
- `prompts.<name>`: the rendered template, the processor's expanded text,
  `input_ids` and `token_type_ids`. Cases: one image, two images, two images
  back to back, multi-turn, a system prompt, text only.

`--run-ir` adds the vision IR's rows for two images (needs the weights).
